rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` has skill front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill link to files for specialized material, and each such link must say when to read the file. The file has three Markdown links to reference files, and each one says when:

- **`references/ci.md`** ("CI example") appears in "Use the [CI example](references/ci.md) when adding these steps to an existing workflow". That is a clear condition.
- **`references/distributed-requirements.md`** appears in "read … before drafting it, and whenever you edit a `{req}` that contains `{sites}` or `{violations}`". It follows "For an obligation that applies separately at each of many sites". That is a clear condition.
- **`references/syntax-details.md`** appears in "If a file that implements or tests a requirement cannot carry a comment, such as a shipped skill…, or a requirement lives in a nested chapter, read …". That is a clear condition.

The mention of the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md` is not a link. It is tied to the `{fixme}` role, which says when it applies. No violation queries are listed, and I found no link that lacks a when-to-read statement.
